page.overview:
Who is TenSoon?

TenSoon is a kandra of the Third Generation. He was one of the most experienced kandthumbra due to the length of his field service. He held two Blessings during the Final Empire, the Blessing of Potency and the Blessing of Presence. He raised MeLaan. He is known as the Guardian of the Ascendant Warrior after the Catacendre.
